organizations.What they build: German motion-technology supplier of bearings and drives, including actuators (motor, gearbox and sensing combined into a robot joint). In August 2026 it announced formed strain wave gearboxes for humanoid joints, with mass production planned for 2027. Its May 2026 agreement with UK robot maker Humanoid targets a four-digit number of robots deployed by 2032 and a seven-digit actuator supply commitment; these are staged future commitments, not completed deliveries.

Swiss maker of precision DC and brushless motors, gearheads, encoders and motor controllers. At Automate 2026 it demonstrated an IP67 integrated drive and humanoid joint actuators combining motors, gearboxes, encoders and control electronics. Its Young Engineers Program offers selected student teams subsidized prices or product sponsorship; eligibility is not guaranteed.
organizations.Warm contact path: unknown; public application route: maxon Young Engineers Program (not a warm introduction)

organizations.What they build: German maker of strain wave gears and precision drive systems for robotics, medical equipment, aerospace and space. A strain wave gear uses an elastically deforming gear element to obtain high reduction ratios in a compact joint; the company markets zero-backlash gear products. No market-share claim is established here.
German family company for grippers, toolholding and workholding. In 2026 it signed a partnership with Bosch Robotics to co-design an industrial-grade robot hand for humanoid robots.

German family-owned automation supplier headquartered in Esslingen am Neckar. It provides pneumatic and electric drive technologies, automation software and AI solutions, while Festo Didactic supplies technical education and training systems.

German motion-plastics supplier of self-lubricating bearings, cable chains and automation components. Its ReBeL cobot arms form part of Iggy Rob, a wheeled mobile manipulator announced in 2025 with two arms, bionic hands, lidar and 3D cameras. The 2025 coverage cited an intended price of €47,999 (about $54,500 then), not a verified current quote. In June 2026 igus announced the Iggy Rob Home service variant from €55,000; that is a different variant and price from the 2025 industrial announcement.
Danish maker of end-of-arm tooling for cobots: electric and vacuum grippers, force/torque sensors, tool changers, plus D:PLOY software for palletizing, CNC tending and packaging.

German chipmaker supplying power semiconductors, microcontrollers, sensors, connectivity and safety/security components for robots. Its Infineon Mobile Robot (IMR) demonstrates these subsystems. AdapTronics won its 2026 humanoid robotics startup challenge; Reuters reported a March 2026 Nvidia partnership covering robot hardware and digital-twin development.

Franco-Italian chipmaker headquartered in Geneva, supplying STM32 microcontrollers, MEMS motion sensors and motor-control electronics. In 2026 it acquired a stake in RoBee builder Oversonic Robotics. Reuters reported its March 2026 Nvidia partnership focused on connecting camera and motion sensors to Nvidia-based robot systems; this is not evidence that ST builds RoBee.

Dutch chipmaker: processors, sensing (radar, vision, UWB), Ethernet/TSN and CAN networking, security and functional safety for drones, AMRs and humanoids. Announced physical-AI work with Nvidia in Mar 2026.

Dutch edge-AI chip startup. Its Metis chip (~214 TOPS at ~10 W) uses digital in-memory computing to run vision models on robots and cameras. Raised more than $250M in Feb 2026 (led by Innovation Industries, with BlackRock and Samsung Catalyst).

Italian electronics and software platform, now a Qualcomm subsidiary, known for open-source microcontroller boards and the Arduino development environment. Its 2026 VENTUNO Q pairs a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 processor (up to 40 dense TOPS of AI compute) with an STM32H5 microcontroller for real-time control. Arduino boards were already used in robots before this dedicated robotics product.
UK maker of low-cost Arm single-board computers (Raspberry Pi 5), Pico microcontroller boards (RP2 chips), cameras and add-on boards; widely used as the 'brain' of hobby and student robots.
German industrial sensor maker: safety laser scanners, lidar, 2D/3D vision and other sensors used on AMRs and in factory automation.

UK maker of the Shadow Dexterous Hand (tendon-driven, five-fingered research hand with tactile fingertips) and the DEX-EE hand. In Oct 2026 it started a six-month project with Fraunhofer IFF on dexterous hands, tactile sensing and teleoperation for manufacturing.
Swiss ETH spin-off making compact 6-axis force-torque sensors (MiniONE, Rokubi, SensONE, LaxONE) with integrated electronics and IMU, plus tactile sensors, so robots can 'feel' contact forces.

German provider of integrated servo drives, motion-control electronics and functional safety for robotics. In August 2026 it announced a partnership with Stabilus to develop and manufacture integrated humanoid joint actuators. The partners target scalable production; the announcement does not establish that the joint product line is already shipping.

Zurich physical-AI startup, legally Eta Robotics AG, developing force-aware dexterous manipulation. Rather than relying only on vision or fingertip sensors, it captures force information through actuators and redesigns the hardware-to-model stack. It emerged from stealth in October 2026 with a reported $30M pre-seed round from redalpine, Notion Capital, firstminute and angels including Arthur Mensch and Yann LeCun.

Budapest startup developing 3D Tissue Braiding to manufacture compliant robot bodies. It produces a scaffold, braids soft tissues and routes tendons, then connects actuators: this is not a claim that motors emerge fully assembled from the braiding step. Its investor confirmed a $7.2M pre-seed in February 2026, including individual angels from OpenAI and Hugging Face, not corporate investment by those companies.

Italian startup developing electro-adhesive gripping interfaces with tactile feedback. Its proprietary thin-film Electro Active Adhesive Layer (EAAL) is mounted on a conformable backing and activated by a 24 V electronic unit to hold objects without suction or fingers. It won Infineon’s 2026 humanoid robotics Startup Challenge; suitability for a specific object still needs testing.

robots_models.Name: Schaeffler formed strain wave gearbox
robots_models.Price / access: B2B; price unknown; mass production planned for 2027
robots_models.Key specs: Formed flex spline for compact, high-reduction humanoid joint gearboxes; validation announced in August 2026, mass production planned for 2027.
robots_models.Why it matters: A manufacturing approach intended to reduce gearbox component production time, cost and material use; a component, not a complete robot.

robots_models.Name: HMND 01 Alpha
robots_models.Price / access: B2B; commercial deployment agreement with Schaeffler; unit price unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Wheeled industrial humanoid unveiled in September 2025. The May 2026 Schaeffler agreement targets a four-digit robot rollout by 2032, with phase one scheduled for December 2026–June 2027; not an already delivered fleet.
robots_models.Why it matters: Concrete robot behind the Schaeffler supply-and-deployment agreement; distinguishes product identity from a future purchasing commitment.

robots_models.Name: maxon integrated joint actuator
robots_models.Price / access: Demonstrated product; price and ordering availability unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Demonstrated at Automate 2026: brushless DC motor, back-drivable two-stage planetary gearbox, dual encoders and control electronics; power and EtherCAT connection. Exact commercial model name and availability unknown.
robots_models.Why it matters: Integrated joint hardware can reduce actuator assembly work; the cited demonstration is not proof of off-the-shelf availability.

robots_models.Name: Harmonic Drive strain wave gears
robots_models.Key specs: Zero-backlash, high-ratio strain wave gears and gear units
robots_models.Why it matters: Compact precision gearboxes for robot joints; no evidence in the source establishes their share of all robot-arm joints.

robots_models.Name: SCHUNK-Bosch humanoid robot hand
robots_models.Key specs: Joint development of an industrial-grade humanoid hand by SCHUNK and Robert Bosch Robotics GmbH, announced in June 2026; development/demonstration stage, not a confirmed commercial release.
robots_models.Why it matters: European industrial hand designed for humanoids.

robots_models.Name: igus ReBeL cobot
robots_models.Why it matters: Lightweight collaborative arm used as an Iggy Rob subsystem; price suitability for the student lab still requires a current quote.

robots_models.Name: Iggy Rob
robots_models.Price / access: 2025 announced target: €47,999 (about $54,500 at the time); current price/availability unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Original 2025 industrial configuration reported with two ReBeL arms, bionic hands, lidar and 3D cameras on an AMR base (wheels, not legs). The 2026 manufacturer announcement distinguishes Industrial and Home variants based on ReBeLMove Pro; configuration and pricing depend on variant.
robots_models.Why it matters: Low-cost wheeled humanoid from a component maker.

robots_models.Name: OnRobot 2FGP20
robots_models.Key specs: 2FGP20 electric palletizing gripper: 20 kg payload, customizable arms and slip-sheet handling. OnRobot separately lists a 2FGP20 Fork for bottom-supported handling; do not conflate the two configurations.

robots_models.Name: Infineon Mobile Robot (IMR)
robots_models.Price / access: Robotics demonstration/development platform; price and kit availability unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Mobile hardware demonstration platform for Infineon motor-control, sensing, microcontroller and CAN communication subsystems; not a software simulator.
robots_models.Why it matters: Reference design for learning robot electronics.

robots_models.Name: RoBee
robots_models.Key specs: Cognitive humanoid built by Oversonic Robotics for manufacturing and healthcare trials. STMicroelectronics became an investor in 2026; that investment alone does not prove it is a robot user.
robots_models.Why it matters: Shows a chipmaker investing in a European humanoid.

robots_models.Name: Axelera Metis
robots_models.Key specs: Metis edge-AI accelerator: up to 214 TOPS at INT8, typical 10 W according to Axelera; digital in-memory computing. Peak throughput and typical power are separate vendor metrics, not a measured robotics workload.
robots_models.Why it matters: European edge AI accelerator for on-robot vision.

robots_models.Name: Arduino VENTUNO Q
robots_models.Price / access: Pre-orders reported September 2026; current price and delivery timing unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (40 dense TOPS) + STM32H5 MCU, RPC bridge between AI and real-time brains
robots_models.Why it matters: Single board for AI + motor control on student robots.

robots_models.Name: Shadow Dexterous Hand
robots_models.Key specs: Five-fingered tendon-driven hand: 20 actuated degrees of freedom and 4 under-actuated movements (24 joints total), including palm flex and 2 wrist joints; tactile fingertip options. Commercial hardware; ROS software integration does not make the hand design open source.
robots_models.Why it matters: Reference dexterous hand used in manipulation research.

robots_models.Name: Bota SensONE
robots_models.Key specs: 6-axis force-torque sensor family with integrated electronics and IMU. SensONE T5 is a high-sensitivity variant reported in March 2024; that date is not the first release year of the whole SensONE family.
robots_models.Why it matters: Adds force feedback for contact-rich learning tasks.

robots_models.Name: Synapticon-Stabilus humanoid actuators
robots_models.Key specs: Integrated actuator product line jointly announced by Synapticon and Stabilus in August 2026, targeting humanoid joints from wrists to hips and knees; software, sensing, drive electronics and functional safety integrated with mechanical design.
robots_models.Why it matters: European joint-actuator development aimed at series production; current shipping status and commercial model names unknown.

robots_models.Name: AdapTronics EAAL gripper
robots_models.Price / access: Contact manufacturer; public price and ordering availability unknown
robots_models.Key specs: Electro-adhesive thin-film interface on a conformable backing, powered by a 24 V electronic unit, with tactile/proximity sensing feedback; performance claims are vendor-reported.
robots_models.Why it matters: Novel gripping without suction or fingers.
